title: Hedging in Academic Writing
text:
Academic writers rarely state their claims with absolute certainty. Instead, they rely on hedging devices such as 'may', 'appears to' and 'tends to' to signal that a finding is provisional. Such language protects the author from overstatement and invites further scrutiny. In many disciplines, a carefully hedged sentence is regarded as a sign of intellectual rigour rather than weakness.

Consider the sentence 'The results suggest that the policy may have contributed to the decline.' The verb 'suggest' and the modal 'may' together soften the assertion considerably. A reader is therefore expected to interpret the claim as a plausible hypothesis, not a settled fact. Mastering this register is essential for anyone wishing to publish in English-language journals.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what purpose do hedging devices serve?
options: They make claims appear absolutely certain
They signal that a finding is provisional
They replace the author's data entirely

questions.text: In paragraph two, which two words together soften the assertion?
What can the reader infer about how academic writers view hedging?
options: They regard it as a sign of weakness to be avoided
They regard it as a legitimate marker of careful scholarship
They use it only in journal titles
They believe it is required only in the sciences

questions.text: Why would a researcher who wants to publish in English-language journals need to master this register?
options: Because journals reject every hedged statement
Because editors expect claims to be presented as provisional rather than settled
Because hedging is grammatically required in English

vocabulary.definition: the use of cautious language to avoid stating a claim too strongly
temporary or subject to later change
a claim that goes beyond what the evidence supports
seeming likely to be true or acceptable

paragraph_translations: Akademik yazarlar iddialarını nadiren mutlak bir kesinlikle ifade eder. Bunun yerine, bir bulgunun geçici olduğunu belirtmek için 'may', 'appears to' ve 'tends to' gibi çekinceli dil araçlarına başvururlar. Bu tür bir dil, yazarı abartıdan korur ve daha fazla incelemeyi davet eder. Birçok disiplinde, dikkatli bir çekince içeren cümle zayıflık değil, entelektüel titizliğin bir işareti olarak kabul edilir.

'The results suggest that the policy may have contributed to the decline.' cümlesini düşünün. 'Suggest' fiili ve 'may' kipi birlikte iddiayı belirgin biçimde yumuşatır. Bu nedenle okuyucunun iddiayı yerleşik bir gerçek değil, inandırıcı bir hipotez olarak yorumlaması beklenir. Bu üslubu öğrenmek, İngilizce dergilerde yayımlanmak isteyen herkes için zorunludur.
